# List of acts of the 6th session of the 4th Parliament of the United Kingdom

#REDIRECT List of acts of the Parliament of the United Kingdom from 1812#52 Geo. 3
This is a complete list of acts of the 6th session of the 3rd Parliament of the United Kingdom which had regnal year  52 Geo. 3. This session met from 7 January 1812 until 30 July 1812.
